paragraphs.text: Crab is a creature type used for various, predominantly marine, crustaceans.

Crabs are characterized by a broad, flattened head and trunk covered by a hard carapace with a small abdomen concealed beneath it, short antennae, and five pairs of legs, of which the anterior pair is large and pincer-like.
A related race is the Homarids .
Crabs are most prominent in blue , with black and green being the most common secondary colors. Riptide Crab is the only white -aligned crab, and Red Death, Shipwreaker is the only red -aligned crab.
The first creature to bear the type was Giant Crab in Tempest .

After Naga had been incorporated into the Snake type and Cephalids into the Octopus type, it was discussed if homarids and camarids should retain their creature type or should be incorporated in the Crab or Lobster type. However, currently crabs and homarids remain separate types.
Crabs are found on several planes of the multiverse, including Amonkhet , Avishkar , Dominaria , Fiora , Innistrad , Ravnica , Shenmeng , Theros , and Zendikar .

Some Innistradi crabs are known to grow to monstrous sizes. During The Travails , some crabs became warped by Emrakul 's influence, such as Vexing Scuttler and Drownyard Behemoth . Crab horrors could be found on Innistrad after the Travails, but it is unclear if this is a lingering effect of the Eldrazi Titan's influence or a normal part of the plane's biosphere.

Crabs are a common subject or donor for Simic krasises. Crab traits can be seen in Skitter Eel , Shambleshark , Sharktocrab and Scuttlegator . Several Simic elves were modified with crab elements, as seen in Growth Chamber Guardian and Scuttling Sentinel .
Mechanically, crabs tend to be high-toughness creatures with simple to no abilities.
Simic Keyrune is a mana stone that can become a 2/3 green and blue Crab artifact creature with hexproof.
